newsitem.title: JAPAN: Miyazaki Bank to issue new shares.
newsitem.headline: Miyazaki Bank to issue new shares.

text.p: Miyazaki Bank Ltd said on Tuesday that it had decided to issue 28.60 million new shares at 320 yen per share in order to increase its capital.
Through the issue of new shares, the bank expects to raise 9.15 billion yen, the bank said in a statement.
The Miyazaki-based regional bank also said that it would implement a one for 1.1 share split on May 20 in order to return profits to shareholders.
New shares will be allotted to investors who own Miyazaki Bank shares as of February 3, 1997. The bank will allot 0.26 new shares for every one share.
Applications for the new shares should be made on March 7-17, 1997, and the payment date is set for March 31, 1997, it said.
As a result of the new share issue, the bank's capital adequacy ratio is expected to rise to 10.43 from 9.43 percent as of the end of September 1996.
On Tuesday, the bank's shares closed down three yen at 692 yen.
